visual.general_description: Three vertically stacked line graphs sharing one printed clock-time x axis, each with a printed y-axis label: "Paw (cmH2O)" in yellow, "Pes (cmH2O)" in pale yellow and "PL (cmH2O)" in green, on gray plot backgrounds with horizontal gridlines.
visual.detailed_description: The figure is a single image with three stacked plots on a gray background with horizontal gridlines. The top plot is titled on its y axis "Paw (cmH2O)" with printed tick labels 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35. The middle plot is labeled "Pes (cmH2O)" with printed tick labels -15, -10, -5, 0, 5, 10, 15. The bottom plot is labeled "PL (cmH2O)" with printed tick labels 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35. Only the bottom plot carries x-axis tick labels, clock times 10:20:21, 10:20:22, 10:20:23, 10:20:24, 10:20:25, 10:20:26, 10:20:27, 10:20:28, and the x-axis title "Time". No data labels, legend box, arrows or panel letters are printed. Qualitatively, the top trace repeats a rise followed by an abrupt fall and a gradual decline over the cycle; in the second cycle its rise is longer and ends in a broad flat-topped segment before the abrupt fall, and a short partial fourth cycle appears at the right edge. The middle trace dips downward in each cycle between flat segments; in the second cycle it instead shows a prolonged raised segment that gradually increases before falling back, and the last cycle has a brief dip. The bottom trace rises to a peak in each cycle and falls to a low flat segment; in the second cycle it peaks, then declines gradually to a lower broad shoulder before an abrupt drop, and the last cycle shows a smaller peak. The three traces are time-aligned: the broad flat-topped segment in the top trace, the prolonged raised segment in the middle trace and the shoulder in the bottom trace occur in the same cycle.

visual.general_description: Two CT slices labeled A and B: A is a reformatted chest image with a neck and upper-chest soft-tissue region and two white arrows; B is an axial chest image with two white arrows near the mediastinum.
visual.detailed_description: Two side-by-side grayscale CT images with printed panel labels "A." at the upper left of the left image and "B." at the upper left of the right image. Panel A shows the upper chest and lower neck in a vertical (reformatted) view in a lung-and-soft-tissue display, with both lungs, the mediastinal vessels and heart outline, the ribs along both sides and arm soft tissue at the edges. Two white arrows are drawn: one points into the soft tissue of the neck/upper chest region on the right side of the picture, where dark streaky gas-density areas are seen within the soft tissue, and one points to the upper part of the chest on the left side of the picture. A small boxed letter "A" appears at the lower right corner of panel A. Panel B shows an axial slice at the level of the aortic arch with both lungs, sternum at the top, spine at the bottom and the bright contrast-filled aorta near the center. Two white arrows point inward toward the mediastinum from the left and right of the picture, at dark gas-density areas surrounding the mediastinal structures. Both lungs show diffuse hazy and reticular opacities with small dark airspaces. No patient name, date or device text is visible.
